meta.title: Technical Stage tab reached manually when not opened automatically
gaps: Verify that the vendor clicked “I will participate” and was not automatically taken to the Technical Stage before manually selecting the tab
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the vendor clicked “I will participate” and was not automatically taken to the Technical Stage before manually selecting the tab

steps.note: Create the multi-stage event used to reach the vendor's Technical Stage.
Configure the event with a Technical Stage.
Work on the Technical Stage before configuring it.
Add a line item so the vendor can see Line Item Specifications.
Populate the Vendor Assessments and line-item technical questions.
Complete the required technical-stage evaluator setup.
Invite the QA vendor whose portal view will be tested.
Publish the technical event for vendor access.
Verify the event is available on its project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Leave the vendor on the event overview/details view before manual tab selection.
Manually select the Technical Stage tab next to Details.
Verify that the Technical Stage screen opened.
Confirm the Vendor Assessments section is displayed.
Confirm the Line Item Specifications section is displayed.
